safety_health_committee_001.evidence: Employees shall report unsafe or hazardous conditions to their Building Administrator or immediate supervisor. The concern will be assessed by appropriate District staff to identify the source and/or extent of the condition. Employees shall not be required to work under unsafe or hazardous conditions, or to perform tasks that endanger their safety.
